summary: i18n verification of AdminDispatchBoard (service.disp_*) and CommsHubPage (service.comms_*) in EN and DE. Dispatch Board works perfectly - renders fully translated in both EN and DE with zero raw-key leaks (verified header 'Dispatch Board', 'Needs dispatch (2)' / 'Benötigt Zuweisung (2)', 'Sorted by priority · SLA', 'Engineers (1)' / 'Techniker (1)', 'X open · Y today' / 'X OFFEN · Y HEUTE', 'Pick' / 'Auswählen', 'Assign' / 'Zuweisen'; assign modal labels Engineer, '— select engineer —', Start time, Est. minutes, Cancel/Abbrechen, Assign/Zuweisen). All 52 keys under service.disp_* and service.comms_* exist in en/fr/de locale files with proper translations (verified via JSON diff). HOWEVER: The CommsHubPage component is orphaned in the UI — no live route mounts it, and there is no 'Comms' nav item in the Service Desk sidebar, so the page cannot be reached by an end user.
